# SDL2 for Zig

Vendored SDL **2.32.10**, packaged for Zig 0.17.1.

Upstream: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/tag/release-2.32.10

Source archive: `SDL2-2.32.10.tar.gz`

SHA-256: `5f5993c530f084535c65a6879e9b26ad441169b3e25d789d83287040a9ca5165`

Upstream commit: `5d249570393f7a37e037abf22cd6012a4cc56a71`.

Supported targets are **Linux, Windows desktop, macOS, and Emscripten**.
This Zig build rejects other operating systems and Android ABIs explicitly.
